lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: Grid-like arrangement of high-luminance circular clusters posterior to the branchial region, organized into approximately seven visible vertical columns on the mid-lateral flank.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect with circular high-luminance blobs, creating a series of anchor nodes that define a rectangular coordinate system across the flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Two prominent horizontal linear features running across the upper third of the flank, characterized by a sharp luminance transition with light-saturated upper edges and shadowed lower edges.

dorsal_fin_surface_patterning.internal_spot_density: Sparse distribution of approximately 5-7 high-luminance blobs visible within the macro-mask of the first dorsal fin silhouette, primarily clustered toward the anterior base.

other_distinctive_markers: Pronounced gradient in spot diameter and frequency, transitioning from high-density, low-diameter clusters on the cephalic region to low-density, high-diameter clusters on the posterior flank.
